AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions: This app manages on-device facial detection and identity recognition. Operational Patterns: - Use 'getRegisteredPersonCount' to verify if the face recognition database has enrolled persons before querying. - Use 'searchPersons' to resolve a person's name to their unique 'id' before calling 'deletePersonById'. - Use 'openLiveDetection' to launch the camera preview when the user wants to start live recognition or enroll faces. Constraints: - Queries are case-insensitive. - Person IDs must be non-empty valid strings.
